sourceMethods: All 128 active subnet slots and 96 September 30–October 1 channel briefs reviewed.

Signed-in X team searches and follow-up search for SN38 ChronoLLM, SN78 UMI and SN50 Synth read. 285 public account candidates sampled and 482 dated post records screened; candidates include quoted accounts and commentators, not just subnet teams.
176 repository paths scanned and 32 selected commit details inspected. New SN117 release assets, SN22 task API and SN78 competition API checked directly.
Signed-in AlphaGap 119-subnet leaderboard, SubnetRadar, TAO Daily, TAO Media, primary partner statements and 52 dated Moments reviewed.
September 24–30 editions checked for previous coverage, unresolved incidents and still-upcoming events. All-roster market outliers and leading emission recipients compared with selections.
YouTube Videos and Live tabs checked; latest public upload title, date and 31:03 duration verified. Latest members upload and October 1 SN49 stream retained.
accessGaps: Research cutoff 2026-10-01T15:10:00.467Z; includes material September 30 announcements after the previous edition's cutoff. X searches and public profile samples are not exhaustive; no Grok scan is claimed.
12 repository paths returned errors and 10 public account candidates exposed no usable posts. Some directory identities differ from current chain names.
Channel briefs are AI-generated secondary summaries. Team-attributed operational claims stay developing; community reports and allegations do not prove deployment, cheating or recovery.

No financial transaction, miner payout, contract, independent model benchmark or security certification was executed or verified in this scan. Code changes, published policies, testnet operation and production activation are distinguished.

SN78 UMI rewards remain explicitly inactive in its public API. SN120 Affine's new verification trials are nonpayable; finalized current transition payouts were not reconciled. SN44 Score's Person-track recovery and SN114 SOMA reruns remain unconfirmed.

SN55 NIOME's scoring investigation, unrestricted SN94 Cathedral mining, SN108 ChipForge activation, SN118 Ditto admission/reward recovery and SN88 Oops first conviction payout remain without new independent completion evidence.
SN82 current identity remains unverified after re-registration. Its seven-day return spans the identity transition and is not treated as a catalyst for the former project.

decisions.reason: The seven-day return spans the old deregistration and new registration already tracked in prior editions. Current project identity and a new primary catalyst are unverified; attributing this transition return to the former project would be misleading.

editorialDecisions: No five-star story selected: the leading items have meaningful primary evidence, but nothing in this window justified inflating an announcement, testnet, pilot or price change into five stars. No X posts authorized for this October 1 daily run.

SN22 live crawl task verdicts distinguish the running crawl track from built-but-gated embeddings and future fine-tuning. Root API URL 404 was not misreported as outage; documented /v1/tasks returns 200.

SN28 customer routing checked against SN105 reply. SN14 first-customer statement is primary but commercial terms and measured benefits are undisclosed. Prior conference demonstration dated September 28, new first-customer post September 30.

SN78 current public API: 165 submissions, open intake, ready evaluation, rewards_active false and chain_submission_authorized false. Previous missing-reward watch updated with exact status. Convo relationship is discussions, not finalized integration.

SN120 equal-registration policy has cutoff and two-day deadline, no-submission behavior with zero eligible models, and no automatic restoration of old payouts. New experimental inference pipeline remains nonpayable. Public operational logs do not independently establish finalized current reward distribution. Internal credential locations and development-host details omitted.

SN81 four jobs relies on team-attributed brief plus verified hot-job code; no independent payout. AlphaGap later 24-hour USD return about 13.5%, compared with earlier TAO.com 23.74%; neither establishes catalyst or a five-star rating.
SN50 original six-part team thread located through signed-in X and read. New volatility score is specific to Crypto 1h; no trading profit or accuracy superiority inferred.
SN117 v0.2.0 published at 15:05:46 UTC with macOS/Linux assets, resolving previous first-release gate. Credit balances are not profit and public release does not guarantee production admission.

SN38 attestation issue and repair covered rather than lost during selection; team source attribution distinguished from a miner self-test report. SN44 petrol scores do not resolve Person-track incident. SN114 sandbox reruns remain planned.

SN104 live testnet with October 2 mainnet target; no completed mainnet launch. SN124 open-source environment promised, SN122 integrations under screening, SN15 test pack promised; not completed launches.

SN61 KYC and backdated buyback intention are not executed purchases. SN66 reopen reported, completed miner run not independently verified. SN121 task integrity report attributed and no named-miner allegation or unsupported false-positive conclusion repeated.

SN55 ongoing scoring investigation, SN118 screening backlog and reward-tree proposal, SN108 expected Oct2–3 activation and SN88 expected first conviction payout have no fresh independent completion; retained in gaps instead of fabricated resolution.

SN26 Perturb/Kinitro directory identity mismatch and vague buyback post unresolved; no amount, transaction or current subnet mapping asserted. SN92 historical MicroTensor repository may not match current Available identity; code not attached to wrong subnet.

Emission leaders SN51, SN64, SN4, SN120, SN107, SN53, SN44, SN8, SN3, SN80, SN15 and SN68 reviewed. SN51, SN4, SN120, SN44, SN8, SN80 and SN15 covered. SN64 phone demo, SN107 Studio preview, SN53 partner demo and SN3 ongoing training already covered or unchanged; SN68 new production milestone not confirmed.

SN41 scoring identity/burn code, SN74 repository weighting preset, SN25 qualification docs and SN108 setup docs screened; no independently activated new mechanism or material new customer launch selected. SN47 pre-alpha verification and SN31 intended launch remain unverified as completed. SN34 and SN65 teasers lack specific release evidence.

Moments coldkey swap at block9184483, 2026-10-01T00:59:21.658Z has no verified subnet-owner identity; wallet migration does not establish project sale. SN106 conviction addition 3.6k alpha at 2026-09-30T16:03:49.592Z is not a lock reduction or new proof of ownership transfer. Price/whale labels do not establish motives or news causation.

Latest public TmGJBuSoqrI verified 1863 seconds, September30 publish date; added before 1J8va16QaMQ. Existing member FqFmRffEgVU retained. SN49 NAbCyYwZ_5w schedule17:00UTC retained with expiry20:00UTC. Removed videos remain absent.
